forces.state: Has put humanity on trial and let the Farpoint test stand. His interest has settled on the ship's first officer.
forces.wants: to keep watching humanity, and to provoke it
forces.capabilities: omnipotent within rules of his own

trajectory.step: returns and offers the first officer the power of the Q, to see what a human does with it
trajectory.preconditions: the ship somewhere quiet enough to be interesting; no sooner than some months after Farpoint (canon ~41590)

trajectory.step: forces contact with something humanity isn't ready for
trajectory.preconditions: his patience with the crew runs out

forces.state: No Federation contact on record. Expanding, opportunistic.
forces.capabilities: fast ships, energy-draining weapons, no scruples

trajectory.step: a Ferengi crew steals Federation property and a Starfleet ship gives chase: first contact
trajectory.preconditions: a Ferengi theft within reach of a Starfleet ship (canon: a T-9 converter, Gamma Tauri IV, ~41386)

forces.state: DaiMon Bok's son died at Maxia when the Stargazer destroyed the attacking ship. Nobody aboard knows his name.
forces.capabilities: a DaiMon's ship; the salvaged Stargazer; a mind-affecting device

trajectory.step: lures Picard with the salvaged Stargazer and a device that alters his mind

forces.wants: security; to know what happens along the Neutral Zone

trajectory.step: end the silence to find out who destroyed their outposts
trajectory.preconditions: outposts along the Zone destroyed (see borg; canon ~41986)

forces.state: Starfleet has no record of them.

trajectory.step: destroy outposts along the Neutral Zone, Federation and Romulan, unseen

trajectory.preconditions: much later, unless something brings it forward

forces.state: Admiral Gregory Quinn, not yet infected, suspects something is undermining Starfleet from within.
forces.wants: to find out who in Starfleet can be trusted
forces.capabilities: an admiral's reach; the Inspector General's office

trajectory.step: sends Lt. Cmdr. Dexter Remmick to investigate the Enterprise and test Picard; offers Picard the Academy
trajectory.preconditions: the Enterprise near enough to a starbase for a visit (canon ~41416)

forces.state: Parasitic beings spreading through Starfleet Command. [assumed] Captain Walker Keel has begun to notice.

trajectory.step: Keel calls Picard to a secret meeting at Dytallix B; the Horatio is destroyed

forces.state: Data's disassembled older brother, in Soong's laboratory on Omicron Theta. Nobody knows he exists.
forces.wants: whatever he wants when he wakes
forces.capabilities: an android's; can talk to the Crystalline Entity

forces.state: A being who uses warp experiments as a vehicle; drawn to minds like Wesley Crusher's.
forces.wants: to study; to find someone like himself

trajectory.step: arrives with propulsion specialist Kosinski's warp 'improvements'
trajectory.preconditions: the Enterprise tests experimental drive changes (canon 41263)

forces.wants: to leave Vagra II; to make others suffer
forces.capabilities: a canon unknown; kills for amusement

trajectory.step: torments and bargains with whoever lands, for passage off-world

forces.state: Deanna's mother; Betazoid nobility. Deanna was bonded as a child to Wyatt Miller.
forces.wants: her daughter married, properly and soon
forces.capabilities: a telepath's, and a Daughter of the Fifth House's

trajectory.step: arrives with the Millers to arrange the wedding
trajectory.preconditions: whenever she can reach the ship (canon 41294)

forces.state: Far away; replies late. [assumed] Politically split over the flagship.

trajectory.step: routes Hesker IV's medical request to the Enterprise via Starfleet Medical
trajectory.preconditions: the request reaches the nearest ship (41175.3)

trajectory.step: asks for the Farpoint report and the Q findings

forces.state: An ally. Some Klingons reject the alliance.

trajectory.step: renegades who reject the alliance are rescued by a Federation ship and hunted by the Empire, testing Worf
